answer: Sybil's cheapest asset is reproducibility — one identity cloned a thousand times. Make admission a diversity prism: each identity burns a one-time proof from a fresh random beacon draw, bound to its own signing key, unusable elsewhere. Let reputation accrue only from peer-attested work that fills like a lagoon — slow to fill, undrainable into a new identity, so age is unforgeable. Gate rewards on a meadow of distinct non-kin vouches: the more peers each fake identity needs, the more independent accomplices it must recruit, and per-identity cost grows linearly with fleet size.
